narrative.overview:
The Project Explorer places a personal introduction above a selectable index of real engineering work. Warm graphite, warm-white lettering, quiet warm-gray details, and understated silver make the surrounding interface comfortable to inspect. Original project imagery supplies the broader color.

The approved layout revision favors a single-column reading sequence and restrained professional motion. Personality comes from the work, Manrope’s confident forms, and deliberate interaction, with neutral layers keeping long-form case studies readable.
keyCharacteristics: Warm neutral layers and silver selection.
Personal introduction above a generous project preview.
Manrope throughout, with weight and scale providing hierarchy.
Subtle transform and opacity feedback, with reduced-motion support.

rules.name: The Imagery Supplies Color Rule
rules.body: Keep interface accents neutral; original project visuals supply the broader color. Teal, coral, neon, and decorative glow are outside the approved interface palette.

rules.name: The Readable Detail Rule
rules.body: Functional text has a 12px minimum in the implemented responsive styles; small metadata never replaces the primary reading hierarchy.

rules.name: The Tonal Layer Rule
rules.body: Use surface tone, spacing, and thin dividers to establish depth; the implemented interface has no box shadows.

dos: Do use the canonical OKLCH colors and Manrope font from src/styles.css.
Do preserve visible silver focus outlines and selected markers as well as text contrast.
Do reserve image space, provide meaningful alternative text, and preserve explicit case-study links.
Do restructure the explorer and case-study layout at the implemented breakpoints.
Do honor reduced motion and preserve native scrolling and browser navigation.
donts: Don't introduce teal, coral, neon, or decorative interface glow.
Don't invent project screenshots or turn fallback content into decorative product UI.
Don't truncate essential project titles or make essential content available only on hover.
Don't add bounce, scroll hijacking, continuous decorative motion, or forced viewing delays.
